facts.summary: An authorized PDS administrator can manage beneficiary or customer records through the applicable PDS administration system.
management_operations: Add a new customer or beneficiary when permitted.
Review customer details required for PDS administration.
Manage customer records according to applicable system permissions.
how_to_access: Log in using the authorized administrator account.
Open the customer or beneficiary management section.
Save changes through the authorized system workflow when applicable.
customer_information: Ration-card-related information maintained by the system.
Contact or address information where maintained.
Other beneficiary information required for PDS administration.
facts.add_customer: If the system permits customer creation, the administrator should enter the information required by the applicable PDS system and complete any required verification.
facts.update_customer: Authorized administrators may update customer information when the applicable system and administrative procedure permit such changes.
facts.verification: Customer information should be verified according to the applicable PDS administrative procedure before creating or modifying records.
facts.access_control: Customer and beneficiary information should only be accessed or modified by authorized users.
facts.privacy: Beneficiary information must be handled only for legitimate PDS administration and according to applicable privacy and access-control requirements.
facts.state_specific: The available customer-management operations, required fields, verification process and permissions can differ between States and Union Territories.
important_notes: Only authorized administrators should manage customer records.
Do not modify beneficiary information without proper authorization.
Do not assume that every administrator can perform every customer-management operation.
The exact fields and workflow depend on the applicable PDS system.
Do not expose beneficiary information to unauthorized users.

faqs.question: Can an admin manage customer records?
faqs.answer: An authorized PDS administrator can manage beneficiary or customer records through the applicable administration system.

faqs.question: What can an admin do with customer records?
faqs.answer: Depending on permissions, an administrator may view, add or update customer information and perform other authorized record-management operations.

faqs.question: How can an admin add a customer?
faqs.answer: If customer creation is supported, the administrator should open the customer-management section, enter the required information and complete the applicable verification process.

faqs.question: Can an admin update customer information?
faqs.answer: An authorized administrator may update customer information when the applicable system and administrative procedure permit it.

faqs.question: Who can access customer records?
faqs.answer: Customer records should only be accessed or modified by users who have the appropriate authorization and permissions.

faqs.question: What customer information can an admin manage?
faqs.answer: Depending on the system, this can include beneficiary identification, ration-card information, contact or address information and other data required for PDS administration.
